races.paceDynamic: Pleasant Man is the only natural front runner in a field dominated by hold-up horses, meaning he can dictate proceedings without pressure and set a sustainable gallop. With 10 of 12 runners preferring to be held up, this creates a tactical nightmare where many will be fighting for the same piece of real estate in the straight, while Pleasant Man enjoys a soft lead that could prove decisive.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pleasant Man Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Pleasant Man gets an uncontested lead and maintains his rhythm
scenarios.body: He dictates fractions without pressure and has enough left to resist the late charge. The hold-up brigade get in each other's way when the pace quickens.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Closer Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuine enough to set up the race for a closer
scenarios.body: Latin or One Million Dreams get the perfect trip tracking the leaders and unleash a telling finish. Pleasant Man pays for his front-running efforts in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Division Gets Perfect Split
scenarios.trigger: If the field splits and creates a clear passage for a horse tracking in fourth or fifth
scenarios.body: Lenny's Spirit or Under The Sun avoid the traffic and benefit from a good position closer to the pace. They get first run on the leaders while others are still finding daylight.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Into Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Pleasant Man goes too slow early and the field bunches up turning for home
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy sprint where any of the hold-up horses could prevail depending on luck in running. Form goes out the window as it becomes about who gets the clearest passage.
